title: spergularia rubra var. media
intro: Spergularia rubra var. media, commonly known as red sandspurry, is a plant species in the family Caryophyllaceae. It is a perennial herb with red or purple flowers, native to Europe, Western Asia, and North Africa. The health benefits of red sandspurry include its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help to reduce stress and anxiety. The bioactive constituents of Spergularia rubra var. media include flavonoids and phenolic acids, which exhibit therapeutic actions such as antimicrobial and anti-inflammatory activities, although more research is needed to fully understand its effects.
